disclaimer: All kits are original Cloudy work, MIT-licensed, and free to download. Art and sound are generated in code. Review and playtest your own changes before you ship them.

kits.title: Cloud Hop
kits.summary: Jump the sky islands, grab the stars, and reach the beacon. Coyote time and a jump cut are already wired in.
kits.controls: ← → or A D to move · Space / ↑ / W / tap to jump

kits.title: Neon Drift
kits.summary: A wave shooter in a neon arena. Stay moving, lead your shots, and learn two enemy behaviors you can remix.
kits.controls: WASD / arrows to move · Mouse to aim · Click or Space to fire

kits.title: Cellar Crawl
kits.summary: A turn-based dungeon crawl with fog, flasks, pests, and stairs. The generator and seed are yours to twist.
kits.controls: Arrows or WASD — one step per turn, bump to attack

kits.title: Skyline Dash
kits.summary: An endless rooftop run with jumps, ducks, gaps, and a local high score. The speed curve is one constant away from a new feel.
kits.controls: Space / ↑ / tap to jump · Down / S to duck

kits.title: Star Forge
kits.summary: Tap a star, buy generators, and collapse the forge for a prestige bonus. The economy is a single table in game.js.
kits.controls: Click the star or press Space · buy from the shop

kits.title: Prism Match
kits.summary: Swap adjacent gems, chain cascades, and spend 25 moves wisely. Board size and colors are constants, not magic.
kits.controls: Click or tap two adjacent gems to swap

kits.title: Orbit Garden
kits.summary: Steer a craft around a floating island and gather orbs. Three.js is vendored, so the kit runs offline.
